description: This script is a Perl program that creates a firmware image by combining kernel and root filesystem images, with options for customization such as addresses, sizes, and image order. It includes functions for reading files, padding data, and generating a specific image format for embedded systems.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads entire contents of a specified file into a scalar buffer.

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates the padding length needed to align data to a specified block size.

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to align to a block size, considering an offset.

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Generates a firmware image with a header, kernel, and root filesystem, and writes it to the output file.
